payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP with min jumps per index; monotonic stacks optimize transitions satisfying height conditions from previous relevant indices.
payload.rationale: Solution maintains dp[i] = min jumps to i. Initialized from dp[i-1]+1. Two monotonic stacks (decreasing and increasing) help quickly find valid previous indices with discrete jump condition, updating dp[i] in O(1) amortized per index.
